content: Canonical htmx examples: delete-row = hx-delete on button, empty 200 response, hx-swap='delete' on closest tr. edit-row = hx-get returns the row in edit form; Save uses hx-put + hx-include='closest tr'; Cancel re-GETs the read-only row; a 'cancel' hx-trigger enforces single-row editing. progress-bar = outer div hx-trigger='done' hx-get='/job', inner div hx-get='/job/progress' hx-trigger='every 600ms' with role=progressbar aria-valuenow. file-upload = hx-encoding='multipart/form-data' + htmx:xhr:progress(loaded,total) event, which REQUIRES a JS/hyperscript handler to move a progress element — htmx has no declarative progress bar.
